sources.title: Qwen3-Max: Just Scale it
sources.evidence: Official article dated September 24, 2025 identifies Qwen3-Max, describes its base as over one trillion parameters and MoE, and introduces Instruct through Alibaba Cloud and Qwen Chat. Read through indexed primary-page content; direct page rendering returned no text.

sources.title: Newly released models
sources.evidence: Release table explicitly dates qwen3-max and qwen3-max-2025-09-23 to September 24, 2025; January 23, 2026 snapshot adds integrated thinking/non-thinking modes and tool capabilities.

sources.title: Model pricing
sources.evidence: The qwen3-max alias is documented as equivalent to qwen3-max-2026-01-23, supporting thinking and non-thinking. The separate September 23, 2025 snapshot is non-thinking only.

sources.title: Text generation models
sources.evidence: Indexed primary documentation dated September 11, 2026 lists qwen3-max with 256k context, thinking, function calling and structured output. This is historical documentation; the direct non-trailing-slash page has since been revised.

sources.title: AI inference fees
sources.evidence: qwen3-max is explicitly text-input-only and used for content generation. Its fee table includes text output in thinking and non-thinking modes, and input tiers through 258,048 tokens. The page marks it as sunsetting soon.

sources.title: Pushing Qwen3-Max-Thinking Beyond its Limits
sources.evidence: January 25, 2026 article identifies the thinking model API as qwen3-max-2026-01-23. It describes reasoning, coding and tools but gives no exact total or active parameter counts.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Max: A New Bar for Coding and Cowork
sources.evidence: August 2026 announcement explicitly calls Qwen3.8-Max the first Max-class model whose weights will be opened, corroborating the earlier Qwen3-Max hosted release rather than an open checkpoint. Its 2.4T/95B figures do not apply to Qwen3-Max.

sources.title: Qwen3-Max exact model and snapshot specifications
sources.evidence: Parent read the complete indexed primary page, including separately titled qwen3-max-preview and January2026 sections. Both explicitly list262144 context. Preview tables mark Function Calling unsupported across regions; the main alias supports it in Beijing. Direct parser exceeded size limit; current endpoint operation was not tested.

name.note: Official styling is Qwen3-Max; baseline spacing is a display convention.

developer.note: Qwen Team model released through Alibaba Cloud.

release_date.note: The official release log lists September23 availability in China; global/international availability and blog publication followed September24.

open_weights.note: Hosted API/chat release; subsequent official announcement identifies Qwen3.8-Max as the first Max-class open-weight release. No open checkpoint equivalence is asserted.

license.note: No downloadable-weight license applies to this hosted release. API service terms are distinct.

parameters_b.note: Launch article discloses only a strict lower bound above 1,000B for Qwen3-Max-Base. An exact scalar and a precise count for the later alias target are not disclosed; do not record 1,000B as an exact total.

active_parameters_b.note: No active parameter count in the reviewed exact-model announcements. Do not borrow figures from open Qwen checkpoints or Qwen3.8-Max.

architecture.note: The original Qwen3-Max base architecture is explicitly MoE. Current alias documentation supplies no detailed architecture revision/configuration.

context_window.note: Exact262144 context appears in the separately named model section of the indexed primary card; no inference from rounded256k.

modalities.note: Exact hosted model is text-input-only and generates text; chat application media features are not model modalities.

reasoning.note: Current documented qwen3-max alias resolves to the January 2026 thinking-capable snapshot; false describes the original September snapshot only.

tool_call.note: Official exact-model documentation supports function calling and tool-using agents.

description.value: Hosted Qwen3 text model for coding, reasoning, and tool-using agents.
description.note: Removes time-sensitive flagship wording and reflects current documented alias capabilities.

patch.description: Hosted Qwen3 text model for coding, reasoning, and tool-using agents.
patch.notes: First documented China availability is September 23, 2025; global rollout and launch post followed September 24. The alias now maps to the January 23, 2026 snapshot with thinking support. The original base is MoE with over 1 trillion parameters; exact total and active counts remain undisclosed. Exact context is 262144 in the indexed model card.

summary: Confirmed MoE and later thinking support; exact total and active counts remain undisclosed. Parent resolved context to 262144 and earliest China launch to September 23 using primary model and release tables.
